subject: Insurance
title: Fighting Back: Anti-Fraud Technology
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Fighting Back: Anti-Fraud Technology.

hook.text: Insurers now spend $10 billion a year fighting fraud with AI, blockchain, drones, and satellite imagery.

buildup.text: Drones photograph storm damage from above, comparing before-and-after images.

discovery.text: Blockchain tracks policy and claims data immutably.

twist.text: Fraudsters adapt too. They use deepfake photos, AI-generated documents, and synthetic identities.

climax.text: Technology won't eliminate fraud, but it's making it harder and riskier.

quiz.question: How are drones used in fighting insurance fraud?
options: They photograph damage for before-and-after comparison
